mapper.sql: WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.test_domain=#{domain} AND e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND e.round_id=#{roundId} AND e.cycle_id=#{cycleId} AND e.directory_id=#{directoryId} AND (c.case_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.case_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND e.executor_id=#{executorId} AND e.execution_status IN #{status} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_defect_execution x WHERE x.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND x.execution_id=e.id AND x.relation_state='ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_defect_execution x WHERE x.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND x.execution_id=e.id AND x.relation_state='ACTIVE') AND c.invalidated=1 AND c.invalidated=0
mapper.select: SELECT s.physical_subsystem_id id,s.physical_subsystem_id physical_subsystem_id,p.code,p.short_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(p.short_name,''),REPLACE(p.name,'物理子系统','')) name FROM tm_test_participating_system s JOIN arch_physical_subsystem p ON p.id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.enabled=1 AND s.deleted=0 ORDER BY p.code
SELECT id,round_code,round_name,status,sort_no FROM tm_test_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT c.id,c.round_id,c.cycle_code,c.cycle_name,c.status,c.sort_no FROM tm_test_cycle c JOIN tm_test_round r ON r.id=c.round_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.deleted=0 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.sort_no,c.id

SELECT d.id,d.physical_subsystem_id,d.round_id,d.cycle_id,d.parent_id,d.directory_name,d.sort_no,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution e WHERE e.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND e.directory_id=d.id AND e.deleted=0) execution_count FROM tm_test_execution_directory d WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.test_domain=#{domain} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0 ORDER BY d.sort_no,d.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id

SELECT e.id,e.case_id,e.directory_id,e.round_id,e.cycle_id,e.execution_status,e.executor_id,x.display_name executor_name,e.executed_at,e.actual_result_html,e.remark_html,c.case_code,c.case_name,c.case_type,c.test_level case_nature,c.priority,c.invalidated,c.updated_at case_updated_at,s.scope_code,s.scope_name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution l JOIN tm_test_defect f ON f.id=l.defect_id AND f.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND f.deleted=0 AND f.status<>'RESOLVED' WHERE l.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND l.execution_id=e.id AND l.relation_state='ACTIVE') defect_count FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id JOIN tm_test_scope s ON s.id=c.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user x ON x.id=e.executor_id AND x.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND x.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.case_codec.case_namee.execution_statuse.executed_ate.updated_at ASC DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT id FROM tm_test_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND scope_id=#{scopeId} AND invalidated=0 AND deleted=0
SELECT id FROM tm_test_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND case_code=#{caseCode} AND deleted=0
SELECT id,case_code,case_name,physical_subsystem_id,invalidated FROM tm_test_case WHERE id=#{caseId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND directory_id=#{directoryId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_execution_directory SET parent_id=#{parentId},directory_name=#{name},sort_no=#{sort},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND directory_id=#{directoryId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution_directory WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_id=#{directoryId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_execution_directory SET deleted=1,deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.*,c.case_code,c.case_name,c.case_type,c.test_level case_nature,c.priority,c.invalidated,c.precondition_html,c.steps_html,c.expected_result_html,c.remark case_remark,c.updated_at case_updated_at,s.scope_code,s.scope_name FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id JOIN tm_test_scope s ON s.id=c.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE e.id=#{id} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT a.attachment_id id,f.file_name,f.file_size,f.content_type,a.sort_no FROM tm_test_execution_attachment a LEFT JOIN att_file f ON f.id=a.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.execution_id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0 ORDER BY a.sort_no,a.id

SELECT f.id,f.defect_code,f.summary,f.status FROM tm_test_defect_execution l JOIN tm_test_defect f ON f.id=l.defect_id AND f.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.execution_id=#{id} AND l.relation_state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.proposed_at DESC

SELECT t.*,u.display_name operator_name FROM tm_test_execution_trace t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.operator_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.execution_id=#{id} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_execution SET execution_status=#{status},actual_result_html=#{actual},remark_html=#{remark},executor_id=#{userId},executed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE tm_test_execution SET directory_id=#{directoryId},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE tm_test_execution SET deleted=1,deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution l JOIN tm_test_defect f ON f.id=l.defect_id AND f.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND f.deleted=0 AND f.status<>'RESOLVED' WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.execution_id=#{executionId} AND l.relation_state='ACTIVE' AND l.defect_id=#{defectId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect WHERE id=#{defectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE' AND defect_id=#{defectId}
SELECT defect_id FROM tm_test_defect_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE'

SELECT c.case_code,c.case_name,s.scope_code,s.scope_name FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id JOIN tm_test_scope s ON s.id=c.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE e.id=#{executionId} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect_execution SET execution_id=NULL,relation_state='SNAPSHOT',snapshot_case_code=#{case_code},snapshot_case_name=#{case_name},snapshot_scope_code=#{scope_code},snapshot_scope_name=#{scope_name},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id FROM tm_test_execution_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_execution_attachment SET deleted=1,deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project WHERE id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_participating_system WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND enabled=1 AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_round WHERE id=#{roundId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_cycle c JOIN tm_test_round r ON r.id=c.round_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.id=#{cycleId} AND c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.deleted=0 AND r.deleted=0
SELECT * FROM tm_test_execution_directory WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM tm_test_execution WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_system_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role_code IN ('TEST_MANAGER','TESTER') AND deleted=0
